name: In Stasis And In Space
source:
In Stasis And In Space is a gay romance space opera where you play as the Commander's younger brother. The story takes place within Soteria Infinity: a residential ark sailing through the eternal void in the hopes of reaching a new home planet at the end of its voyage.

Embark on an adventure between planets, manage your team and commandeer your ship, build lasting relationships or cut them short, and establish respect among the ark... 

... all the while reminding your protective older brother that you're more than capable of holding a gun!

[From [url=https://collins-kitt.itch.io/in-stasis-and-in-space]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《In Stasis And In Space》是一部同性恋浪漫太空歌剧，你将在其中扮演指挥官的弟弟。故事发生在Soteria Infinity中：一艘住宅方舟航行穿过永恒的虚空，希望在航行结束时到达一个新的家园星球。

踏上行星之间的冒险之旅，管理你的团队并征用你的飞船，建立持久的关系或缩短关系，并在方舟中建立尊重…… 

…一直提醒你的保护哥哥，你完全有能力拿枪！

[来自[url=https://collins-kitt.itch.io/in-stasis-and-in-space]Itch.io[/url]]
